title: Cascade Pass to Sahale Glacier
map_label: 3D view of North Cascades National Park following the hiker up the Cascade Pass and Sahale Arm trails to Sahale Glacier

end.name: Sahale Glacier (end of Sahale Arm Trail)

stops.commons_file: Cascade Pass Trail at North Cascades in Washington 14.jpg
stops.alt: A dirt trail through pink alpine flowers toward a snow-patched peak on the Cascade Pass Trail
stops.title: Into the high country
stops.text: The Cascade River Road ends here, and the trail climbs about {gain} to Sahale Glacier. The photo is from higher up the Cascade Pass Trail, where the trail runs through alpine meadow.

winter.text: The trail climbs about {gain} to Sahale Glacier. In winter it lies under snow and the road can be closed, so check conditions with the park first. The photo shows the same trail in better weather.

stops.commons_file: Cascade Pass at North Cascades in WA - Flickr - landscapesinthewest.jpg
stops.alt: A rocky, snow-streaked peak seen from the trail below Cascade Pass
stops.title: The high peaks appear
stops.text: The trail climbs steadily, and the rocky peaks around the pass start to show above you.

stops.alt: A wide green glacier-carved valley seen from the trail just below Cascade Pass
stops.title: The valley opens up
stops.text: Just below the pass, a wide green valley opens out beside the trail.

autumn.text: Just below the pass, the valley slopes turn red and gold beside the trail.

winter.text: Just below the pass, the valley fills with snow and the trail disappears under it.

spring.text: Just below the pass, snow still lies in the valley while the lower slopes turn green.

stops.alt: Jagged rock peaks above a meadow at Cascade Pass
stops.title: Cascade Pass
stops.text: Cascade Pass. NPS lists it at 3.7 miles from the trailhead; the trail on this map measures about 3.5. The Triplets and Cascade Peak rise above the meadow, and here the trail turns onto Sahale Arm.

stops.alt: Wildflowers beside the trail on Sahale Arm with the jagged Triplets behind
stops.title: Meadows on the arm
stops.text: Past the pass the trail follows Sahale Arm. Flowers line the path, with the Triplets across the valley.

autumn.text: Past the pass the trail follows Sahale Arm, with the Triplets across the valley. The flowers are over and the meadows are turning.

winter.text: Past the pass the trail would follow Sahale Arm, but in winter it is buried in snow, with the Triplets across the valley.

spring.text: Past the pass the trail follows Sahale Arm, with the Triplets across the valley. Snow is still melting back from the path.

stops.alt: Doubtful Lake, a dark blue lake in a rocky basin below a snow-patched peak, seen from Sahale Arm
stops.title: Doubtful Lake
stops.text: A dark blue lake sits in the basin below the arm, under a snow-patched peak.

stops.commons_file: Sahale Arm and Cascade Pass at North Cascades in Washington 09.jpg
stops.alt: A dirt trail across red and gold autumn meadow on Sahale Arm toward a pale rocky peak
stops.title: Autumn colour on the arm
stops.text: In autumn the meadows of Sahale Arm turn red and gold, with the trail winding across them toward the peaks.

summer.title: Sahale Arm in summer
summer.text: In summer the meadows of Sahale Arm are green, with the trail winding across them toward the peaks.

winter.title: Sahale Arm under snow
winter.text: In winter Sahale Arm is buried in snow and the trail is not visible. The photo shows the snow-covered slopes above the arm.

spring.title: Sahale Arm in spring
spring.text: In spring much of Sahale Arm is still under snow, and the meadows have not come out yet.

stops.alt: Dark rocky ridges with patches of snow under a deep blue sky
stops.title: Rock and snow
stops.text: Higher up the meadows give way to bare rock, with snow patches clinging to the ridges.

stops.alt: Clouds drifting through a mountain valley beneath snow-covered peaks
stops.title: Clouds below you
stops.text: Cloud drifts through the valley far below, with the pass somewhere beneath it.

stops.alt: Rocky moraine in the foreground with Doubtful Lake and ranks of peaks beyond
stops.title: The drop to Doubtful Lake
stops.text: Near the top the rocky ground falls away to Doubtful Lake, far below.

stops.alt: A rocky moraine mound and a bright snow slope at Sahale Glacier, with rows of snowy peaks behind
stops.title: Sahale Glacier
stops.text: You are about {gain} above the trailhead, at the end of the trail by Sahale Glacier, 5.9 miles from the start by NPS. The photo shows the moraine beside the glacier.

summer.text: You are about {gain} above the trailhead, at the end of the trail by Sahale Glacier, 5.9 miles from the start by NPS. The photo shows the snow of the glacier.

seasons.note: Season view is illustrative: snow and colour are drawn on the map, not measured. The photos are real.
